PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON;

CREATE TABLE `Species`(
    `Species_id` INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    `avg_Wingspan` REAL NOT NULL,
    `avg_Lifespan` REAL NOT NULL,
    `diet` TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (`diet` IN ('insects', 'rodents', 'birds', 'seeds', 'fruit', 'fish', 'unknown')),
    `common name` TEXT NOT NULL,
    `scientific name` TEXT NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE `users`(
    `user_id` INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    `username` TEXT NOT NULL,
    `date_Joined` TEXT NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE `Bird`(
    `id` INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    `Species_id` INTEGER NOT NULL,
    `Name` TEXT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (`Species_id`) REFERENCES `Species`(`Species_id`)
);

CREATE TABLE `Bird Sighting`(
    `sighting_id` INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    `bird_id` INTEGER NOT NULL,
    `person_id` INTEGER NOT NULL,
    `location` TEXT NOT NULL,
    `Sighting date` TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (`bird_id`) REFERENCES `Bird`(`id`),
    FOREIGN KEY (`person_id`) REFERENCES `users`(`user_id`)
);
 What bird has been seen the most?  
SELECT b.id, b.Name, COUNT(*) AS sighting_count
FROM Bird b
JOIN `Bird Sighting` bs ON b.id = bs.bird_id
GROUP BY b.id, b.Name
ORDER BY sighting_count DESC
LIMIT 1;

questionResults.question: What species has the longest wingspan
questionResults.sql:
SELECT s.`Species_id`, s.`common name`, s.`avg_Wingspan`
FROM `Species` s
ORDER BY s.`avg_Wingspan` DESC
LIMIT 1;
questionResults.friendlyResponse: The Wandering Albatross has the longest wingspan.

questionResults.question: What species in our database has the longest wingspan and what do they eat
questionResults.sql:
SELECT s."scientific name", s.diet, s.avg_Wingspan
FROM Species s
ORDER BY s.avg_Wingspan DESC
LIMIT 1;
questionResults.friendlyResponse: The species with the longest wingspan in your database is the bald eagle (Haliaeetus leucocephalus), and they primarily eat fish.

questionResults.question: What bird was seen last
questionResults.sql:
SELECT b.id, b.Name, bs.`Sighting date`
FROM Bird b
JOIN `Bird Sighting` bs ON b.id = bs.bird_id
ORDER BY bs.`Sighting date` DESC
LIMIT 1;
questionResults.friendlyResponse: The last bird seen was Athena on August 22, 2026, at 7:55 PM.

questionResults.question: what day of the week are more birds seen on
questionResults.sql:
SELECT strftime('%w', `Sighting date`) AS day_of_week, COUNT(*) AS sighting_count
FROM `Bird Sighting`
GROUP BY day_of_week
ORDER BY sighting_count DESC
LIMIT 1;
questionResults.friendlyResponse: More birds are seen on Saturdays.
